content: ORAVIG buccal tablets, each containing 50 mg of miconazole, are off-white in color. These tablets are designed with one rounded side and one flat side. They are supplied in bottles containing 14 tablets, identified by the National Drug Code (NDC) 43288-250-14. The recommended storage conditions for ORAVIG are at a controlled room temperature of 20 to 25°C (68 to 77°F). However, short-term temperature excursions between 15 and 30°C are acceptable. It is essential to protect the tablets from moisture and to store them in a location that is inaccessible to children.
